title: Declarative Model Metaclass
instructions: Build the declarative model machinery in `declarative.py`: the `Field` descriptor, the `ModelMeta` metaclass (`__prepare__` that rejects duplicate definitions, `__new__` that collects fields across the MRO, handles the `table=` keyword and generates `__signature__`) and `Model.__init__` / `create_sql`. The skeleton `__new__` only swallows `table=`; replace it with the real logic.

evidence.label: Collects fields in declaration order, inherited ones first
Defaults the table to lowercase name plus 's' and honours table=
create_sql renders CREATE TABLE with columns in field order
inspect.signature shows keyword-only fields and defaults are applied
Missing required or unknown fields raise TypeError
Redefining a name in a class body fails at class creation
Class access returns the Field, which knows its name
A subclass can override a field without reordering or touching the base
Other class keywords reach __init_subclass__ via type.__new__
Each instance stores its values in its own __dict__
